تستضفن (form X)
# تَسْتَضِفْنَ (tastaḍifna) /tas.ta.dˤif.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَضَافَ (istaḍāfa)
# تُسْتَضَفْنَ (tustaḍafna) /tus.ta.dˤaf.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَضَافَ (istaḍāfa)
